plan.command:
export ENOUGH=10000 TIMING_O=0 LOOP_O=0
exec ./lmbench_all lat_syscall -N 1 -P 1 null

ip link set lo up
ip link add audit0 type dummy || exit 90
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/32 dev audit0 || exit 91
ip link set audit0 up || exit 92
exec ./busybox sh ./netperf_testcode.sh

ip link set lo up
exec ./busybox sh ./netperf_testcode.sh
